items.title: Claude / ChatGPT projects as a PM context hub
items.why: Persistent project context means you stop re-explaining your product in every chat — set it up once, every draft gets sharper.

items.title: v0 / Lovable — working prototypes from a PRD
items.why: Paste your requirements, get a clickable UI in minutes. Changes the conversation with design and engineering from abstract to concrete.

items.title: Granola — AI meeting notes without a bot
items.why: The note-taker strong PM teams have quietly standardized on. If you're still writing meeting notes by hand, this is an hour a week back.

items.title: Deep-research modes (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini)
items.why: Multi-source, cited market research in one prompt. Doesn't replace your judgment — replaces two days of tab-hopping.

items.title: MCP (Model Context Protocol) — what it means for PMs
items.why: The standard connecting AI assistants to your tools (Jira, Notion, analytics). Worth understanding before your team asks you to spec against it.
